bank.meaning: Deduplicated purchasable compounds physically listed in the two uploaded laboratory inventory exports; not a reaction database and not the earlier MCule catalog.
bank.structure_resolution: Names and CAS identifiers were resolved through the local PubChem cache.

rough_detection.tier_1: Highest target-similarity 5% of the full bank: 96 structures.
rough_detection.tier_2: Highest gap-region-similarity 5% of the remaining bank: 92 structures.

result.interpretation: The asymmetric natural-product test is a partial geometric recommendation, not a complete retrosynthesis. Chemical reactivity and chirality refinement were not applied because no full rough cover was found.
